connector.name: Neo - AI/ML Engineering by NeoResearchAI
connector.registryDescription: AI/ML engineering MCP server for Neo - submit tasks, track execution, and retrieve outputs.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the Python package neo-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the neoresearchai account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: NEO_SECRET_KEY
env.description: Your Neo API secret key (starts with sk-v1-). Get one at https://heyneo.com.

env.name: NEO_WORKSPACE_DIR
env.description: Absolute path to your project/git root where Neo writes files. Required for Postman and recommended for all clients.
